replay.couplings: P2 L8 dialogue, pattern, chunks and recall agree after the reorder. Trophy example is a separate valid sentence; terms and required tokens remain correctly anchored. Its revised first reply has seven eojeol.

fullCoverage.fields: Read path metadata; every lesson title, situation, goal, register, all four turns and both bases, pattern label/rule/examples/highlights, every cloze alternative/cue, every chunk and term/gloss, recall alternatives, speech tokens, captions, trophy explanations, distractors, mood and visual notes. Read the full controlling specification and Fable result; checked Stage 0 identity, register/base evidence and all 200 frozen trophy strings against the bound corpus.

validation.actualGate: validateKoreanB1Draft imported directly through node --import tsx, applied to both reviewed-content files with B1_NATIVE_KOREAN_SPEC.json
checks: No issue: native Korean morphology, particles, standard spacing, NFC and whole-eojeol reconstruction; no substring speech/recall/cloze anchors.
No issue: consistent polite 해요체, appropriate requests and honorific direction, no gendered learner identity/address.
No issue: P1 background, sequence, interruption and two-sentence progression; P2 -지만, -기는 한데/하지만, -아/어도 and -(으)ㄴ/는데도 progression. Recognition-only forms are not promoted into learner production.
No issue: canonical target/base meanings in German and English, 140 meaningful terms, explicit form cues, natural bare trophy anchors and examples, no opening/scene disclosure of delayed follow-up.
No issue: clinic lesson is a personal recollection; P2 L8 revised concession order is acceptable speech. No medical promise or new spoken blocker identified.
Six actual whole-chip alternative permutations were constructed in memory; all fail the exact comparison used at BuildPhraseStep.tsx:68 despite equivalent meaning.

ComplicationStep.tsx:94 and :178-241 display the interlocutor's base and the cloze, not dialogue[3].baseText. BuildPhraseStep.tsx:100-163 displays the whole meaning cue and target chips, not individual chunk glosses.

TypeRecallStep.tsx:57-84 tests the learned sentence from memory; fallback reveals the canonical answer and does not render fallbackChoices. Finding 03 concerns the stronger specification requirement for unused metadata, not an ambiguous live recall choice screen.
validation.visualVerification: Not performed; source-level rendering/checker inspection only. No runtime integration, audio quality, provider, billing or execution authorization is claimed.
